title: Translation/phase posterior localization makes the Fisher ceiling leading-order exact

localization.normalized_channel: After known-sign demodulation, W_k=a exp(i(Theta+k dot Y))+xi_k on a complete d_N=Theta(N^3) cube, with fixed a>0 and independent Gaussian noise variances uniformly bounded above and below.
localization.shift_estimator: Disjoint adjacent-pair averages have means a^2 exp(iY_j), variance O(d_N^(-1)), and phase risk O(d_N^(-1)) for j=1,2,3.
localization.phase_estimator: A disjoint residual subcube, demodulated by Yhat, gives global-phase risk O(N^2/d_N)=O(N^(-1)).
localization.prediction_bound: The plug-in normalized per-mode risk is O(N^(-1)); posterior means minimize quadratic risk, so K1652's score-weighted missing term is O_(g,eta)(N^3).
localization.scope_guard: The proof uses a complete cubical support, known nonzero equal-magnitude signs, fixed positive amplitude and fixed-shell residual-noise bounds. It is not unrestricted macroscopic-block coercivity.
